body.p: Friends meet in a narrow hall and compare notes on education, law, and ordinary life. Their talk is plain, practical, and full of clean examples. Baruch Spinoza

The page turns and a new idea appears: collective life, the value of labor, and the power of simple institutions. Some listen closely, others laugh, and a few remain silent while nature is mentioned as a guide. David Hume
Nothing here requires a difficult explanation. The language is common, the scene is familiar, and the final point remains modest. Reason closes the paragraph.
